title: Sprint canvas and OKR matrix for enterprise isolated deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a quarter-level sprint canvas and an explicit OKR mapping for Private/VPC/on-prem enterprise features focused on activation cohorts, compatibility gating, and risk-aware capacity hedging. This ticket is the product-level artifact that will be used to align engineering, design and sales on which slices ship in the quarter, the acceptance criteria for tenant activation, and the telemetry signals we track for OKR progress (latency P95, successful tenant activations, upgrade success rate, and unit cost delta). Deliverables: 1) sprint canvas with sprint-by-sprint commitments and fallbacks, 2) OKR matrix that ties deliverables to telemetry and SLA targets, 3) activation pathway templates for low/medium/high-risk customers, 4) dependency map and gating rules. This is intentionally scoped as a planning/decision artifact (not an implementation PRD).
acceptance_criteria: Sprint canvas published with sprint-level commitments and fallback options for each quarter sprint
OKR matrix linked to concrete telemetry queries (dashboards) and target thresholds
Activation pathway templates (low/med/high) documented and validated with Solutions Engineering
All blocking dependencies are listed with owners and provisional dates
Rollout gating rules and rollback criteria defined for at least three customer cohorts
comments: 2026-03-02 – Kickoff: synced with Eng (Liam), Design (Rina), Sales Eng (Amit) to capture worst-case upgrade scenarios and customer cohort definitions. Action: product to draft sprint canvas by 2026-03-08.

2026-03-12 – Decision log: agree to include automated compatibility verifier preflight (ENG-1842) in sprint 2 and decouple noncritical telemetry retention increases to a follow-up patch to avoid scope creep.
